Seabyss II — Beta 0.1.7-beta.47

- Preserves the latest validated Quest Panel visuals and user edits.
- Doubles Gold rewards for all active Quests; XP, Diamonds, and item rewards remain unchanged.
- Sets the Iron Cannon price to 250 Gold while preserving Diamond cannon and cannonball prices.
- Sets Floating Chest base XP rewards to 1–20 while preserving the existing Doubler and Premium behavior.
- Preserves the validated Pirate Exam movement and completion-latency fixes with exactly-once progression and rewards.
- Preserves the current Cauldron UI and compact durable transaction pipeline.
- Adds the validated 512x512 HUD portraits for NPCs, Bosses, and Sea Monsters.
- Adds the validated public online-player count to Login.
- Purchases and all financial gates remain disabled for this Beta release.
